dedupe_keys.name: geographical characterisation of british urban form and function using the spatial signatures framework

description: Geographical characterisation of British urban form and function using the spatial signatures framework is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Martin Fleischmann et al. The spatial arrangement of the building blocks that make up cities matters to understand the rules directing their dynamics. Our study outlines the development of the national open-source classification of space according to its form and function into a single typology. Coverage: a single site or case study; published in 2022. Formats: CSV, GeoPackage. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 1091920552 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
